name: practical-work-kit
description: Practical, tool-optional help for checking work, challenging plans, shaping ideas, and handing off context.

interface.longDescription: Checks documents and software outcomes, tests proposed plans, develops concrete ideas, and preserves context. Works with the information you provide; tools are optional. Replies in your language. No account connections, background hooks, or required forms. Install this bundle OR a standalone role, not both.
defaultPrompt: Check this result and tell me what to fix first.
Challenge this plan and suggest a practical next step.
Turn this idea into a direction that fits my time and resources.
